data.name: Steep the Reliquary Seal
data.description:
Steeping costs the Reliquary Seal and 3 Core Rot. Win the fight and the rot gives you the Rotted Reliquary Seal, which opens The Rotted Reliquary. Lose and the rot spits the Reliquary Seal back out; the Core Rot is spent.
If you carry fewer than 3 Core Rot, choose Take it back: the Reliquary Seal returns and nothing is spent.

You lower the Reliquary Seal into the Core's rot. It drinks.
data.successDescription: You step back from the Core's rot.

objectives.description:
You lower the Reliquary Seal into a pool of the Core's rot. Black water climbs it at once, and something under the surface turns toward it, the way a sleeper turns toward a sound.

Steeping takes 3 Core Rot. Without them, take it back now: the Reliquary Seal comes back and nothing is spent.
The rot stands up out of the pool and becomes the Core Horror.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Core Horror sinks back into the pool. When you draw the Reliquary Seal out, it is dark, soft and heavy with rot: the Rotted Reliquary Seal.
The rot spits the Reliquary Seal back onto the planks beside you, untouched. The Core Rot you poured in is gone.
The pool goes still. It will wait for you.
You draw the Reliquary Seal out of the rot before it takes hold. Nothing is spent.
